summary: vloop run refuses a repository with no [[check]], runs every check on the base before any branch or plan session (logs in checks/base-<name>.log, refusal on failure), copies the config's checks into the plan at acceptance and on every resume, and halts with exit 9 when a check moves a ref or changes .git/config or the hooks.
verified: vloop task gate T7 exited 0 and printed GATE OK.
notes: checks.go has runCheck(root, shell, check, timeout) (log, exit, timedOut, exit-9 guards) for T8 to reuse, plus planChecks/sameChecks. Base checks run with the config shell and run.gate-timeout, before workBranch; the run folder is created first (after a cheap workBranchFree refusal so an existing branch still changes nothing). A refused base check leaves the untracked run folder holding the log, so the tree must be committed or cleaned before re-running. The resume copy lives in Iterator.Run and logs 'the checks changed since the plan was made'. runPreflight skips doctor's 'checks' problem so the planner's own refusal line prints. A resume with no [[check]] is refused too. No tree-restore guard on checks (only refs and .git/config/hooks).
